payloads.name: XPSemu — helper.elf
payloads.description: Required helper payload for the original Xbox emulator XPSemu. Install XPSemu separately from the PS5 Library catalog, then load this helper ELF using kstuff before starting the emulator. Does not contain a BIOS or games.
payloads.author: ZiZc3

payloads.name: Ruffle Flash PS5 — helper.elf
payloads.description: Required helper payload for Ruffle Flash PS5. Install the Ruffle app separately from the PS5 Library catalog, then load this helper ELF with kstuff before starting the app. Flash games are not included.
payloads.author: ZiZc3
